title: NSWC-PHD MATAC OTA Special Notice: MK41 Vertical Launching System - Super ATE
description: NSWC PHD requires a Super ATE solution that consolidates, to the maximum extent practicable, the functions of multiple existing or planned ATE systems into a common, modular, and scalable platform. The objective is to reduce the number of ATE assets required for LSEQ and MCP production; decrease laboratory and production-test footprint; improve test repeatability; reduce setup time; and simplify calibration, maintenance, configuration management, and lifecycle support. NSWC PHD requires Automated Test Equipment (ATE) to support production acceptance testing of MK 41 Vertical Launch System (VLS) Launch Sequencer (LSEQ) and Motor Control Panel (MCP) assemblies, including line-replaceable units (LRUs) within those assemblies. Currently, conducting lifecycle maintenance and testing requires utilizing multiple disparate pieces of test equipment, which creates a large footprint and increases operational complexity. The Government requires an innovative, integrated production-test capability that can consolidate multiple ATE functions into a common Super ATE architecture. The required capability must support complete-box testing, LRU-level testing, acceptance testing, and support for shock and vibration test requirements. Organizations interested in responding to this RFS must be members of MATAC. Visit MATAC.org for more information.

title: NSWC-PHD MATAC OTA Special Notice: MK 341 ITS Advanced Missile Integration
description: The Navy desires the development and integration of a unified MK 341 Interface Test Set (ITS) prototype capable of testing all current and emerging VLS missile variants. This prototype will consolidate the legacy MK 683 and predecessor MK 341 functionalities into a single advanced platform by FY2029. Accelerating the integration of emerging U.S. and FMS missile capabilities, while systematically mitigating obsolescence within the existing MK 341 ITS platform, requires leveraging existing MK41 VLS infrastructure and equipment. To support these compressed timelines, the project prioritizes rapid developmental cycles, direct access to secure government networks, and agile testing methodologies which are most e�ectively delivered through an embedded, collaborative engineering model. The contractor shall conduct all prototype design, development, and integration activities comprehensively on-site at the NSWC Port Hueneme Division (PHD) facility. Furthermore, upon successful completion of the prototype, the contractor will directly execute the fielding of the modernized system to the Fleet. The Government will provide one (1) legacy MK 341 ITS unit to serve as the baseline. The contractor shall utilize this unit to analyze the current system design, identify obsolescence, and develop the integration architecture for the new U.S. and FMS missile variants. Organizations interested in responding to this RFS must be members of MATAC. Visit MATAC.org for more information.

title: SATMO Aviation Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC)
description: In accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 5.201 and 5.203, the U.S. Army Contracting Command - Aberdeen Proving Ground (ACC-APG), Orlando Division, on behalf of the U.S. Army Security Assistance Training Management Organization (USASATMO), intends to issue a competitive Request for Proposals (RFP) for the Aviation Training Support Services (ATSS) Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC). The Contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to form, prepare, deploy, sustain, and redeploy Aviation Security Assistance Teams (SATs) worldwide in support of Foreign Military Sales (FMS) cases and Theater Security Cooperation Programs. Services are divided into two primary functional categories: (1) Training-Related Services and (2) Technical Assistance-Related Services. Required capabilities include tactical flight instruction, maintenance test flight operations, aircraft servicing, maintenance, armament, and operational planning on both Standard U.S. Military Aircraft (e.g., AH-64D/E Apache) and Non-Standard Rotary-Wing and Fixed-Wing Aircraft (e.g., Mi-17, Bell 407/412, Cessna 208). All maintenance, armament, and instruction must maintain U.S. Army airworthiness standards and comply with the Golden Sentry End-Use Monitoring (EUM) program.

title: FMC Lexington - Remove and Replace Treadway Roof
description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons (FBOP) herein issues solicitation 15BBNF27R10900002 for the award of a firm-fixed-price construction contract for a project entitled Replace Treadway Roofs at the Federal Medical Center (FMC) Lexington, located in Lexington, Kentucky. FMC Lexington is a federally owned facility located at 3301 Leestown Rd., Lexington, KY 40511. The project consists of the following: The Federal Bureau of Prisons (FBOP), Federal Medical Center Lexington, Kentucky, intends to award a single contract to a responsible entity to provide all labor, materials, equipment, tools, transportation, supervision, and disposal services required to remove and replace the existing 9,500 sq. ft. roofing system. This includes replacing 20% damaged plywood sheathing, 100% fascia boards , and removal of Dormers. Removal of box gutters with associated downspouts. All work should be performed safely, of high quality, and with minimal disruption to FBOP operations. The facility will remain occupied throughout construction. Contractor is required to attend a pre-work meeting in order to coordinate and plan with the on-site staff prior to the day of work. All work shall comply with local, state, and federal regulations. Access to the specifications and drawings attachments will require an active https://sam.gov vendor registration (log in) AND may require a specific role or domain linked to your registration. If you encounter problems requesting access to these documents, please contact the Federal Service Desk at 866-606-8220. Interested bidders must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at https://sam.gov. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code applicable to this requirement is 238160 (Roofing Contractors) with a corresponding small business size standard of $19 million. The estimated magnitude of the project lies between $500,000 and $1,000,000 (NOTE: This range is not meant to imply that the project has necessarily been estimated/budgeted to the maximum of the selected range. It merely conveys that the estimate/budget lies somewhere within that range.) The solicitation will be distributed solely through the Contract Opportunity website at https://sam.gov. Hard copies of the solicitation will not be made available. The website provides download instructions. All future information about this solicitation, including any amendments, will also be distributed solely through this website. Interested parties are responsible for continuously monitoring this website to ensure that they have the most recent information about this proposed contract action. IMPORTANT: Any contractor interested in obtaining a contract award with the Federal Bureau of Prisons must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at https://sam.gov. If you have questions about SAM, Government procurements in general, or need assistance in the preparation of your bid/proposal/offer, a local Procurement Technical Assistance Center (PTAC) may be able to help. The Procurement Technical Assistance Program was authorized by Congress in 1985 in an effort to expand the number of businesses capable of participating in the Government marketplace. title: NGA HRM-II RFP
description: The National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) is to issue this Request for Proposal (RFP) HM047626R0018 for public response for the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) Human Resource Management II (HRM II). The HRM II RFP will be a commercial effort under FAR Part 12, and the Government anticipates using Best Value � Tradeoff evaluation methods and acquisition procedures as described in FAR Part 15. Contract award will be made to the offeror who provides the best overall value to the Government in terms of evaluation factors listed in Section 5 of the RFP. title: S--BIA Electrical Utility O&M Services
description: Sources Sought Notice: Skilled Electrical Utility Operations and Maintenance Services Agency: Department of the Interior, Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA), Western Region Anticipated PSC: S112, Utilities-Electric Anticipated NAICS: 238210, Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors Disclaimer: This Sources Sought Notice and RFI is issued for market research and acquisition planning purposes only. This is not a solicitation, request for proposal, or request for quotation. The Government is not obligated to award a contract or reimburse any costs associated with responding to this notice. The Government intends to use responses to assess industry capabilities, socioeconomic participation, acquisition strategy, and overall market conditions. Purpose: The BIA is conducting market research to identify qualified firms capable of providing skilled personnel and related support for electrical utility operations, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, testing, metering, and emergency restoration. The Government is particularly interested in responses from Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs) and Indian Economic Enterprises (IEEs). Responses from other small businesses and qualified firms with relevant experience are also requested. Consistent with the Buy Indian Act and applicable regulations, this market research will assist the Government in determining the availability of qualified ISBEEs and IEEs and developing the acquisition strategy. See Attachment 1, Requirement Summary, for a high-level description of the anticipated services. Information Requested: Interested firms are requested to submit a capability statement that includes: Company Information: Company name, UEI, CAGE code, business size, socioeconomic status, and point-of-contact information. Firms claiming ISBEE or IEE status should clearly identify that status in their response. Relevant Experience: Describe similar work completed or performed within the past three years. For each example, identify the customer, scope, location, period of performance, approximate value, and whether your firm performed as the prime contractor or subcontractor. Technical Capability: Describe your firm�s experience supporting electrical utility systems; maintenance and repair operations; metering services; substation support; emergency response operations; and remote or geographically dispersed service areas. Identify the geographic service areas your firm can support and whether your firm can support all three BIA organizations. Safety Record: Provide a brief overview of the firm�s safety program and its most recent Total Recordable Incident Rate, if available. Industry Feedback Requested: The Government seeks industry recommendations regarding: � Contract type, Pricing structure � Single-award versus multiple-award approaches � Ordering methods for routine and emergency work � Appropriate NAICS and PSC codes � Methods to maximize ISBEE and IEE participation � Potential barriers to competition � Other recommendations concerning labor standards, staffing, mobilization, licensing, performance periods, or service-order administration. Response Instructions: Responses should not exceed five (5) pages, excluding a cover page and documentation supporting ISBEE or IEE status. Submit responses electronically to: Lara.Wood@bia.gov Subject Line: Sources Sought Response BIA Electrical Utility Operations and Maintenance Services Responses due: December 9, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. Eastern time. Phone calls will not be accepted. Attachment 1: Requirement Summary The anticipated requirement will support Government-owned electrical utility systems operated by the following BIA organizations: Colorado River Electrical Services (CR-ES) San Carlos Irrigation Project-Power Division (SCIP-PD) Truxton Canon Agency (TCA) Anticipated support may include: Low- and medium-voltage electrical system troubleshooting, diagnostics, maintenance, and repair Planned and emergency restoration activities Utility pole inspection, testing, transport, and replacement support Substation inspection, operation, testing, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair Meter installation, troubleshooting, reading, and related services Switching support, outage response, and emergency call-out services Support in remote or geographically dispersed locations The contractor may be required to provide qualified personnel, supervision, transportation, specialized tools, equipment, vehicles, personal protective equipment, mobilization, and other resources necessary to perform assigned services. Work may be performed within the service areas of CR-ES, SCIP-PD, and TCA, including portions of Arizona and California. Locations include the Colorado River Indian Reservation, Gila River Indian Reservation, San Carlos Apache Reservation, and Havasupai Reservation. Certain locations are geographically remote and may have limited vehicle access. The Government anticipates a combination of planned work and emergency-response requirements. The final scope, contract structure, labor standards, service levels, and ordering procedures will be developed after considering market research results.

title: Class 4 Inshore Patrol Vessels
description: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Air and Marine Operations (AMO), anticipates issuing a solicitation for the design, construction, integration, testing, delivery, and associated logistics support of enclosed-cabin Class 4 Inshore Patrol Vessels (IPVs), including compatible trailers, for use by the U.S. Border Patrol (USBP). The anticipated requirement includes two vessel categories: Patrol Boat-Small (PC1): Vessels 25 feet in length or less, designed for operation in shallow and obstructed waterways, including riverine environments. Patrol Boat-Medium (PC2): Vessels at least 25 feet and no more than 29 feet in length, designed for operation in rougher open-water, coastal, Great Lakes, and other inshore environments. The anticipated contract may provide for the procurement of up to 117 Class 4 IPVs, including up to 31 PC1 vessels and up to 86 PC2 vessels. Each vessel will include a compatible trailer. Actual quantities and ordering requirements will be established in the solicitation and any resulting contract or orders. The contractor will be responsible for providing vessels that meet the Government�s performance requirements. Anticipated contractor responsibilities include program management; vessel design, engineering, fabrication, manufacturing, and integration; contractor-furnished equipment; quality control; configuration management; testing; technical data, manuals, drawings, and provisioning data; warranty support; delivery; and operator and maintenance familiarization training. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, bid, or proposal, as appropriate, which will be considered by the agency.

The material type expected for this requirement will be maintenance material typical for Pensacola Entrance Channel composed of sand. Material dredged will be placed west of the Pensacola Entrance Channel along Perdido Key Beach.

title: Biomedical Research Application Evaluation and Support (BRAES)
description: This is a Request for Proposal (RFP) for Biomedical Research Application Evaluation and Support (BRAES) on behalf of the Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs (CDMRP) within the Defense Health Agency (DHA) located in Frederick, MD at Fort Detrick. This requirement is a performance-based non-commercial, non-personal services support requirement and will be awarded as a Multiple Award Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quality (MA-IDIQ) contract. The CDMRP requires BRAES is for: 1) Funding opportunity announcement set-up within CDMRP electronic Biomedical Research Application Portal (eBRAP) (eBRAP task order awarded to a single vendor); 2) Oversight of electronic receipt and processing of intramural and extramural pre- and full research applications in eBRAP (eBRAP task order awarded to a single vendor); 3) Application compliance review in eBRAP (eBRAP task order awarded to a single vendor); and 4) Scientific merit peer review including operation of a secure Contractor-owned, Contractor-operated web-based electronic system which supports all activities and capabilities specific to peer review (i.e. Scientific Administration and Management/SAM) (SAM task orders awarded to multiple vendors). NOTE: The task orders associated with scientific peer review will be competed as fair opportunity between the successful BRAES Contract holders AFTER award of this MA IDIQ.

title: Finland – Construction work – Ruovedentie 36 Säästökulman kiinteistön purku-urakka
description: Ruoveden kunta pyytää tarjousta omistamansa asuin- ja liikekiinteistö Säästökulman purku-urakasta tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen mukaisesti. Purkukohde sijaitsee osoitteessa Ruovedentie 36, 34600 Ruovesi. Urakka sisältää rakennuksen purkamisen kokonaisuudessaan, purkujätteen asianmukaisen lajittelun, käsittelyn ja poiskuljetuksen sekä purkamisen jälkeiset maanrakennus-, täyttö- ja maisemointityöt. Kohteen sisätiloissa suoritetaan parhaillaan erillinen asbestipurku ja siihen liittyvä siivous laittoman haitta-ainepurun seurauksena. Suoritettavien töiden yhteydessä sisätiloista poistetaan tiedossa olevat asbesti- ja haitta-ainepitoiset materiaalit. Rakennuksen perustuksissa, julkisivuissa sekä muissa rakenteissa saattaa kuitenkin edelleen esiintyä haitta-aineita sisältäviä materiaaleja. Näiden materiaalien purkaminen, käsittely, pakkaaminen, kuljetus ja asianmukainen toimittaminen hyväksyttyyn vastaanottopaikkaan sisältyvät purku-urakkaan urakka-asiakirjoissa esitetyssä laajuudessa sekä voimassa olevien viranomaismääräysten mukaisesti. Tilaajalla on samanaikaisesti tarjouslaskennassa sisällöltään lähes vastaava purku-urakka. Kyseinen kohde sijaitsee noin 50 metrin etäisyydellä tästä purkukohteesta, ja kohteiden väliin jää yksi kiinteistö. Purkutyöt voidaan toteuttaa joko samanaikaisesti tai peräkkäin urakoitsijan tuotantosuunnittelun mukaisesti. Tarjoajaa pyydetään huomioimaan kyseinen mahdollinen synergiaetu tarjouslaskennassaan. Kohteet kilpailutetaan ja tilataan kuitenkin erillisinä toisistaan riippumattomina urakoina. Kumpaankin kohteeseen valitaan erikseen urakoitsija tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen mukaisesti. Valintaperusteena on hinnaltaan halvin hyväksyt-tävä tarjous. Tarjouspyyntödokumentti, soveltuvuusvaatimukset, hankinnan kohde ja tarkemmat hankinnan tiedot tutustuttavissa latauslinkin takaa. Kohteeseen tutustuminen 7.12.2026 klo 9.00–10.00. Ilmoittautuminen esko.moisio@caverion.com, p. 050 347 8206 Urakkaan liittyvät kysymykset on toimitettava esko.moisio@caverion.com 9.12 mennessä. Kysymyksiin vastataan 11.12. Vastaukset julkaistaan kunnan verkkosivuilla Tiedotteet-osiossa www.ruovesi.fi. Tarjoukset jätetään sähköpostilla esko.moisio@caverion.com 23.12 kello 14:00 mennessä.

title: Finland – Repair and maintenance services – Parvekelasien huolto- ja korjauspalvelut / VAV
description: Hankinnan tavoitteena on hankkia joustava yhteistyökumppani Vantaalla sijaitsevien, VAV:n (jäljempänä "Tilaaja") omistamien asuinkiinteistöjen parvekelasien huoltotöihin ja vikakorjauksiin. Tilaajan järjestelmiin kirjattujen vikailmoitusten ja käytettävissä olevien tietojen perusteella arvioidaan, että sopimuksen perusteella voidaan tehdä vuosittain noin 150–250 yksittäistä huolto- tai vikakorjauskäyntiä tai työtilausta. Tarkoituksena olisi myös jatkossa tehdä parvekelasien järjestelmällisiä sarjatöitä / ennakoivaa huoltoa. Em. arvio ei muodosta Tilaajalle vähimmäisostovelvoitetta, ja toteutuva määrä voi alittaa tai ylittää arvion. Tilaaja valitsee yhden Tarjoajan. Hankintapäätöksen tekoperusteena on kokonaistaloudellinen edullisuus, pisteytyksen mukaisesti. Maksimipisteet ovat 1 000 pistettä. Tilaaja edellyttää Tarjoajia tutustumaan huolellisesti kaikkiin hankintailmoituksen liitteisiin sekä sopimusehtoihin. Tarjoajan on annettava tarjous kaikista tarjouslomakkeen töistä. Mikäli Tarjoaja ei ole tarjonnut kaikkia tarjouslomakkeeseen eriteltyjä töitä, tulkitaan tarjous puutteelliseksi. Puutteellinen tarjous hylätään. Tarjoajan kannalta huomioitavaa on myös se, että tarjottujen töiden ja hintojen tulee sisältää kaikki tässä tarjouspyynnössä, hankintasopimusluonnoksessa ja palvelukuvauksessa määritellyt kriteerit. Palvelu toteutetaan tarjouspyynnön, palvelukuvauksen ja laatuvaatimusten mukaisesti. Tarjoajan antama tarjous on sitova. Hankintasopimus syntyy vasta kirjallisen sopimuksen allekirjoittamisella, selonottoneuvottelujen jälkeen. EU-kynnysarvon ylittävässä hankinnassa sopimus voidaan tehdä aikaisintaan 14 vuorokauden kuluttua siitä, kun Tarjoaja on saanut tai hänen katsotaan saaneen päätöksen perusteluineen tiedoksi. Tarjoaja ei saa esittää esimerkiksi omissa tarjousasiakirjoissaan ehtoja, jotka vaikuttaisivat hankintasopimuksen sisältöön. Sopimuskauden tavoitealkamisajankohta on 1.3.2027.

title: Pre-Solicitation Notice for Indefinite Delivery Contract (IDC) for Regional Dredge Multiple Award Task Order (MATOC) - USACE Huntington District - W91237-27-R-A003
description: 1. CONTRACT INFORMATION: The contract consists of a base period of one-year with four option periods, one-year each for maintenance dredging and/or clearing and snagging services for Ohio River Government Lock facilities and Ohio River open channel areas (within commercial navigation limits) located in the geographical boundaries of the following U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Great Lakes and Ohio River Division Districts: Nashville (LRN), Louisville (LRL), Huntington (LRH), and Pittsburgh (LRP). There will be no site visit for this requirement. The award of a target of (3) Firm Fixed price Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity Multiple Award Task Order Contracts (IDIQ-MATOC) is anticipated. The contracts will be awarded to up to three (3) qualifying Offerors. The total capacity for the sum of all task orders issued under these contracts is a shared Not to Exceed (NTE) amount of $45,000,000.00. This announcement is open to all businesses regardless of size. The NAICS code for this procurement is 237990, which has a size standard of $37 million in average annual receipts. If a large business is awarded this contract, it must comply with RFO Clause 52.219-9 Alt II Small Business Subcontracting Plan, Alternate II. Solicitation documents will be available on or about November 10, 2026, and can be downloaded at https://www.sam.gov. 2. PROJECT INFORMATION: The primary objective of this contract is to provide maintenance dredging and/or clearing and snagging services for Ohio River Government lock facilities and Ohio River open channel areas (within commercial navigation limits) located anywhere within the geographical boundaries of the following Great Lakes and Ohio River Division Districts: Nashville (LRN), Louisville (LRL), Huntington (LRH), and Pittsburgh (LRP). This includes work on any navigable tributary of the Ohio River system.3. SELECTION CRITERIA: All proposals will be evaluated on the basis of the factors stated below to award a contract to each and all qualifying offerors. There will be no trade-offs performed. Awards of MATOCs will be made to those offerors that are determined to be a responsible source, submitting a technically acceptable proposal that conforms to the requirements of the solicitation, and the Contracting Officer has no reason to believe would be likely to offer other than fair and reasonable pricing. FACTOR 1: Technical Capability - This factor evaluates the offerors proposed capability to perform specific dredging and related tasks that may be required under the basic contract and all option periods. FACTOR 2: Equipment - Offeror shall provide documentation for all marine floating plant/equipment being proposed for use under this solicitation/contract and any subsequent task orders. FACTOR 3: Past Performance - Provide descriptions of at least one (1) and no more than three (3) projects completed or substantially complete (90% or more) within seven (7) years from issuance of the solicitation that are similar in scope, magnitude, and complexity to the work under this MATOC. Self-performance of at least 50% of the total cost of the project is required. FACTOR 4: Small Business Participation Plan - This factor evaluates the offerors proposed level of participation of Small Business (as prime and/or subcontractor) relative to the following goals: Small Business (SB) - minimum mandatory (23%), Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB) (13%), Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) (5%), Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) (5%), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) (5%), and HUBZone Small Business (3%).4. SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS: Proposers shall submit all documents electronically through PIEE Solicitation Module at www.piee.eb.mil. No paper copies, CD, DVD, thumb drives, email, or facsimile will be accepted. To be eligible for award, a firm must be registered in System for Award Management (SAM). Register via the SAM internet site at www. SAM.gov. Questions may be submitted to Amy L. Davis; amy.l.davis@usace.army.mil. Please note, as of April 2018, GSAs System for Award Management (SAM) system requires new registrations and renewals of existing registrations to submit an original signed notarized letter identifying the authorized Entity Administrator. The notarized letter is not to be submitted to the Huntington Contracting Office as it is not our requirement. Vendors are encouraged to check their entitys status in www.SAM.gov and plan accordingly. If the prospective contractor is not registered in the SAM database, the Contracting Officer will follow the procedures in FAR 4.1103. Contact the supporting Federal Service Desk at www.fsd.gov, or by telephone at 866-606-8220 (toll free) or 334-206-7828 (internationally) Monday through Friday from 8am to 8pm EDT, for free assistance. The SAM registration process may take several weeks to process once submitted. Please carefully consider this information when deciding to submit your proposal.

title: Bravo Dive Boat 65DS1101
description: AMENDMENT 0003 POSTED 11/26. AMENDMENT 0002 POSTED 11/21. AMENDMENT 0001 POSTED 11/19. The Regional Maintenance Center at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS & IMF) intends to award a stand-alone Firm-Fixed-Price contract to accomplish the maintenance, repair, and preservation in support of one (1) 65 FT BRAVO DIVE BOAT 65DS1101. Work will be accomplished at the Contractor's facility. Geographical Area of consideration: To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the West Coast of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. 65DS1101 Length: 69 FT 10 IN Width: 22 FT 0 IN Draft: 3 FT 6 IN Full Displacement: 55 L TONS Age: 13 YEARS Light Load: 8,000 lbs Hull Type: Aluminum Scope Overview: Coordinate with the Contracting Officer, via the Contracting Officer�s Representative (COR) to deliver the vessel to the Contractor�s facility from Puget Sound Naval Shipyard (PSNS) Bremerton, WA. Remove all fendering and sweep blast clean. Accomplish survey of hull to identify and repair corrosion, preserve the exterior above and below the waterline, including the crane. Apply nonskid to horizontal surfaces on the exterior and interior of the boat. Replace motor mounts. Remove, inspect and install shafting, rudders and propellers. HVAC repair. Maintain and repair watertight hatches and doors. Repair, modify and preserve push knee. Replace and modify corroded deck and bulkhead structure in the main cabin. Install remote fuel shut offs. Identify and repair corrosion beneath the transformers in the aft lazzarette, install a weather shield above the starboard transformer in the aft lazzarette. Replace hydraulic, and fuel hoses. Identify and repair corroded structure beneath the shower room drain. Remove windows, repair window heaters, and reinstall windows. Replace fire suppression system piping and recertify system. Repair damage to the port bow. Accomplish modification and repair of swim platform stairs. Restore preservation system on the console in the pilot house. Replace existing generators with supplied Kohler generators, Modify, repair and install fendering system. Modify and repair the monkey heater system. Remove, inspect, preserve and install rudders. Replace thru hull valves and flexible hoses. Replace false bulkheads in the shower room and head. Open, clean and inspect all tanks. Perform sea trials after completion of repairs and full cure time of preservation. Arrange and coordinate the delivery of the vessel back to the Government with the Contracting Officer via the COR. The Period of Performance is expected to be 25 March 2026 to 29 May 2026. This is a 100% Small Business set-aside under the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 336611, size standard 1,300 employees. All offerors must be registered with the System for Award Management (SAM) to receive award of Government contracts. Offerors are advised also that SAM representations and certifications can be completed electronically via the System for Award Management website at https://www.sam.gov. NOTE 1: Please pay particular attention to the inclusion of DFARS 252.232-7998 Obligations in Advance of Fiscal Year 2026 Funding (DEVIATION 2026-O0001). NOTE 2: Please review Request for Quote instructions regarding contract financing.

title: Germany – Architectural, engineering and planning services – Neugestaltung Innenstadt Brake - Nicht offener, einphasiger, freiraumplanerischer Wettbewerb mit verkehrsplanerischen Aspekten und Konzeptteil mit Teilnahmewettbewerb und nachg. Verhandlungsverfahren
description: Die Stadt Brake (Unterweser) beabsichtigt, ihre Innenstadt umfassend aufzuwerten und neu zu ordnen. Als Kreisstadt des Landkreises Wesermarsch liegt Brake am westlichen Ufer der Unterweser im nordwestlichen Niedersachsen, im Städteviereck Wilhelmshaven - Bremerhaven - Bremen - Oldenburg. Der Landkreis ist überwiegend ländlich geprägt und gilt als strukturschwach. Hintergrund der angestrebten Innenstadtumgestaltung ist ein erkennbarer Handlungs- und Steuerungsbedarf der im Kontext der Erstellung eines Integrierte Stadtentwicklungskonzept (ISEK) identifiziert wurde. Nach Einschätzung des ISEKs gelingt es der Innenstadt in jüngerer Zeit nicht mehr ausreichend, ihr Potenzial als Versorgungszentrum für die Region und ihre Bewohnenden zu entfalten. In der Folge erstellte die Stadt Brake (Unterweser) ein Integriertes Handlungskonzept - den sogenannten "Masterplan Innenstadt Brake (Unterweser) - und bewarb sich mit diesem Konzept zur Neuordnung der Innenstadt im Städtebauförderprogramm "Lebendige Zentren. Der Aufnahmebescheid ging im Dezember 2023 ein. Vor diesem Hintergrund soll der Stadterneuerungsprozess über einen freiraumplanerischen Wettbewerb mit verkehrlichen Aspekten und Konzeptteil vorangetrieben werden. Ziel ist es, die architektonische und freiraumplanerische Qualität ebenso wie die funktionale Leistungsfähigkeit der Innenstadt durch vergleichende Entwurfsansätze abzusichern. Dazu werden Planungsteams aus der Landschaftsarchitektur und Verkehrsplanung eingeladen einen Entwurf für die Entwicklung der Innenstadt zu erarbeiten. Teilnahmeberechtigt sind außerdem Stadtplaner in Zusammenarbeit mit Planungsteams aus der Landschaftsarchitektur und Verkehrsplanung. Angesichts der Bedeutung der Innenstadt als Entwicklungsimpuls für die Gesamtstadt wird ein ganzheitlicher, Lösungsansatz benötigt, der städtebauliche, freiraumplanerische und verkehrliche Anforderungen schlüssig zusammenführt. Darüber hinaus sind Themen der Nachhaltigkeit, der Klimafolgenanpassung und der ökologischen Aufwertung als Querschnittsthemen mitzudenken. Weiter sind Barrierefreiheit und Inklusion konsequent zu beachten. Neben der Entwurfserstellung für die zentrale Lage der Innenstadt (Fußgängerzone) werden im Wettbewerbsverfahren vorgegebenen Teilbereiche detaillierter betrachtet und übergeordnet beplant. Das im Wettbewerb überzeugendste Gesamtkonzept wird durch eine Fachjury prämiert. Gegenstand der Beauftragung ist neben der baulichen Neuordnung der innenstädtischen Fußgängerzone die Erarbeitung eines Gestaltungshandbuchs. Dieses soll eine einheitliche und funktionale Gestaltung der gesamten Innenstadt sowie angrenzender Räume ermöglichen und ist im ersten Schritt zu erstellen. Hierzu sollen unter anderem verbindliche Leitideen und Gestaltungsvorgaben zur Steigerung der Aufenthaltsqualität, zur Nutzungsvielfalt und zur Bildung von Begegnungsorten entwickelt werden. Das Gestaltungshandbuch soll konkrete, künftig einheitlich zu verwendende Gestaltungselemente und Materialien festlegen. Diese Vorgaben sind bei sämtlichen zukünftigen Planungen und Maßnahmen zu berücksichtigen. Das Verfahren erfolgt als nicht offener, einphasiger, freiraumplanerischer Wettbewerb mit verkehrlichen Aspekten und Konzeptteil vorgeschaltetem Teilnahmewettbewerb und nachgeschaltetem Verhandlungsverfahren gem. VgV. Im Rahmen des Teilnahmewettbewerbs werden 3 Planungsteams als Teilnehmende für den Wettbewerb ausgewählt. Zusätzlich werden 2 Planungsteams als Teilnehmende für das Verfahren gesetzt. Der Wettbewerbsausschuss der Architektenkammer Niedersachsen hat Kenntnis vom Inhalt dieser Auslobung erhalten und beratend mitgewirkt. Der Wettbewerb wurde unter der Nummer 212-32-26/14 registriert. Die Vergabestelle lässt sich in der operativen Umsetzung dieses Verfahrens durch das Büro D&K drost consult GmbH, Hamburg, unterstützen und beratend begleiten.

title: Germany – Architectural services for outdoor areas – Freianlagenplanung: Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg Altona A7-Deckel
description: Das Bezirksamt Hamburg-Altona plant das Projekt "Deckel Altona" im Rahmen des Ausbaus der Autobahn A7. Es umfasst dabei die Errichtung eines 2.230 Meter langen Lärmschutztunnels mit einer Überdeckung der Fahrbahn und die freiraumplanerische Gestaltung der darauf entstehenden Flächen. Hier wird die Autobahn im Abschnitt Altona von sechs auf acht Fahrstreifen erweitert und durch die Überdeckelung eine städtebauliche Verbindung zwischen zuvor getrennten Stadtteilen hergestellt. Das Tunnelbauwerk überspannt bei einer Stärke der Tunneldecke von 1,28 bis 1,75 m im Regelquerschnitt freitragend Breiten von 21 m, in Aufweitungsbereichen von bis zu ca. 30 m. Entsprechend gelten klare Vorgaben für die auf das Bauwerk maximal aufzubringenden ständigen Lasten sowie zusätzliche Nutzlasten. Auf einer Gesamtfläche von rund 214.000 m² sollen in etwa 119.000 m² Parkanlagen und 95.000 m² Kleingartenflächen realisiert werden. Davon befinden sich ca. 105.000 m² Fläche direkt über dem Tunnelbauwerk. Als Begleitmaßnahme zum Tunnelbauwerk erfolgt ein großer Teil des Bodenauftrags durch eine gesonderte Fachplanung. Die Übergabe der Flächen - nach der Andeckung Unter- und Oberboden, der Erstellung der Wegeaufbauten bis OK ungebundene Tragschicht sowie die Herstellung von Entwässerungsleitungen erforderliche Entwässerungseinrichtungen bis 1,0 m vor der Einrichtung - durch die Fachplanung Boden definiert die Leistungsgrenze, auf welcher die nachfolgenden Gewerke aufbauen. Dabei ist oberhalb der Tunneldecke, sowie in den Randbereichen der Tunneldecke, aus statischen Gründen max. 1,20 Meter möglich.

In dem neuen Herzzentrum werden die Kardiologie, die Angiologie, die Herzchirurgie, die pädiatrische Kardiologie, die Kinderherzchirurgie sowie die Kardio-Anästhesie des Universitätsklinikums Heidelberg zusammengeführt. Durch interdisziplinäre Kooperationen und Innovationen werden Synergien und ein Mehrwert in der Versorgung und der Forschung generiert. Unmittelbar in den Neubau des Herzzentrums integriert und funktional eng damit verbunden wird der wissenschaftliche Arbeitsbereich Informatics for Life (IFL). Durch Fokussierung auf das wissenschaftliche Rechnen in der kardiovaskulären molekularen Forschung wird Fortschritt in der personalisierten Herzmedizin in Deutschland realisiert.

title: Denmark – Electrical installation work – Rammeaftale for Elektronisk og Mekanisk Sikring
description: Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen (herefter benævnt "ETK") ønsker at indgå flere Delaftaler om Elektronisk og Mekanisk Sikring med henblik på sikring af ETK bygninger og anlæg. I det følgende benævnes alle fem (5) Delaftaler som Rammeaftalen. Rammeaftalen omfatter blandt andet levering, installation, programmering, idriftsættelse, integration, service, vedligeholdelse, eftersyn, fejlafhjælpning, reparation, udskiftning, support, etablering af fiberinfrastruktur, dokumentation samt øvrige ydelser med tilknytning til de omfattede anlæg og produkter. Ydelserne leveres i entreprise og omfatter blandt andet Opgaver (under DKK 100.000), Planlagte og periodiske Eftersyn samt akut beredskab til håndtering af opståede fejl og skader i form af Stop skaden opgaver. Projekter (på eller over DKK 100.000) i form af blandt andet planlagt etablering af nye anlæg, udvidelser, ombygninger m.v. Ydermere inkluderer Rammeaftalen håndtering af Kampkraftopbyggende opgaver. Rammeaftalen er opdelt i Delaftaler (herefter under ét benævnt ”Delaftale”) fordelt på fem (5) geografiske områder med fire (4) Entreprenører pr. Region: • Delaftale 1 Nordjylland • Delaftale 2 Midtjylland • Delaftale 3 Syddanmark • Delaftale 4 Sjælland • Delaftale 5 Hovedstaden og Bornholm De fire (4) Entreprenører bliver på hver Delaftale rangeret som henholdsvis bedst/næstbedst/tredjebedst/fjerdebedst Entreprenør, på baggrund af vurderingen ved tildeling af Rammeaftalen i udbudsforretningen. Bedst rangerede Entreprenør på Delaftalen vil få tildelt alle Arbejder med en værdi under DKK 100.000 samt Stop skaden og Eftersyn. Alle Projekter med en værdi på eller over DKK 100.000 vil blive tildelt efter miniudbud blandt Entreprenørerne. Ved miniudbud på Delaftalen, inviteres alle Entreprenører til at afgive tilbud. ETK kan uanset opgavens værdi, under hensyntagen til den konkrete opgaves karakter, omfang og tidsmæssige rammer tildele Kampkraftopbyggende opgaver til den Entreprenør, som ETK vurderer bedst kan varetage den Kampkraftopbyggende opgave. Rammeaftalen omfatter ydelser, der naturligt henhører under Elektronisk og Mekanisk sikring. Rammeaftalen omfatter ikke perimeterhegn. Ydelser inkluderer blandt andet følgende: Elektronisk Sikring • Automatisk indbrudsalarmanlæg (AIA) • Elektronisk adgangskontrolanlæg (ADK) • TV-overvågningsanlæg (TVO) • Porttelefoni • Etablering af fiberinfrastruktur Mekanisk Sikring • Sikringsdøre og sikringspartier i relevante RC-klasser • Gitterdøre og gitterpartier • Glaspartier med og uden RC-klasser • Forstærkning af vægge, gulve og lofter • Etablering og forstærkning af konstruktioner i henhold til specificeret sikringsniveau • Vægmoduler og andre præfabrikerede sikringskonstruktioner i relevante RC-klasser • Rullegitre og rullejalousier • Gitre, bure, løvebure og tilsvarende afskærmninger • Mekaniske låsekasser, beslag og øvrige mekaniske sikringskomponenter • Ikke klassificeret låse, cylindre og nøglesystemer • Tilpasning og reetablering af eksisterende bygningsdele i forbindelse med etablering af mekanisk sikring • Demontering og bortskaffelse af eksisterende mekaniske sikringsprodukter, hvor dette er omfattet af den konkrete opgave Listen er ikke udtømmende. Der kan således i aftaleperioden opstå behov for yderligere ydelser, som naturligt henhører under de ovenfor beskrevne ydelser og deres anvendelsesområde. Rammeaftalen omfatter ikke bygningsarbejder (murer, tømrer, maler osv.) som selvstændige ydelser. Dog skal Entreprenøren ved Arbejder, hvor bygningsarbejder indgår som en nødvendig del, inkludere og koordinere Underleverandører. I sådanne tilfælde vil Entreprenøren have det fulde ansvar for styring, koordinering og kvalitetssikring af samtlige ydelser, uanset om de udføres af Entreprenøren selv eller af dennes underleverandører. Entreprenøren skal således ved tilbudsafgivelsen indregne, at Entreprenøren hæfter fuldt ud over for ETK for udførelsen af disse byggefaglige ydelser. Rammeaftalens samlede maksimumværdi udgør DKK 5.625.000.000. Se en nærmere redegørelse herom i udbudsbetingelsernes afsnit 4.

title: ESA/ NEPA Compliance Support for Klamath Project A
description: (i) This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with the format in Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested, and a written solicitation will not be issued. (viii) Provision 52.212-1, Instructions to Offerors - Commercial Products and Commercial Services, applies to this acquisition. (x) Clause 52.212-4, Contract Terms and Conditions - Commercial Products and Commercial Services, applies to this acquisition. There are not any addenda to this clause. (xi) All additional contract clauses and provisions are included in the attached solicitation package. (xii) The Defense Priorities and Allocations System (DPAS) do not apply to this acquisition. La prórroga será acordada expresamente por el órgano de contratación y será obligatoria para el contratista siempre que el preaviso se produzca con al menos dos meses de antelación a la finalización del plazo de duración del contrato (art. 29.2 LCSP). En ningún caso podrá producirse la prórroga por el consentimiento tácito de las partes. Cada prórroga quedará condicionada a la existencia de crédito adecuado y suficiente en el ejercicio correspondiente y se realizará en los mismos términos del contrato original.

Los títulos o acreditaciones académicos o profesionales exigidos, y los documentos admitidos para su acreditación son: El equipo técnico deberá disponer, como mínimo de tres técnicos que reúnan los siguientes perfiles profesionales: - Para la redacción del Proyecto Básico y del Proyecto de Ejecución, así como para la Dirección de Obra: un Arquitecto que cuente con la titulación habilitante y colegiación oficial correspondiente, la cual se acreditará mediante certificado (original o copia compulsada) de inscripción en el Colegio Profesional competente. - Para la Dirección de Ejecución de la Obra: un Arquitecto Técnico que cuente con la titulación habilitante y colegiación oficial correspondiente, la cual se acreditará mediante certificado (original o copia compulsada) de inscripción en el Colegio Profesional competente. - Para la coordinación de seguridad y salud en fase de Proyecto, técnico con titulación habilitante, que cuente con la titulación y colegiación oficial correspondiente, la cual se acreditará mediante certificado (original o copia compulsada) de inscripción en el Colegio Profesional competente. - Para la legalización de las instalaciones: Un Ingeniero o Ingeniero Técnico Industrial que cuente con la titulación habilitante y colegiación oficial correspondiente, la cual se acreditará mediante certificado (original o copia compulsada) de inscripción en el Colegio Profesional competente. - Para el resto de técnicos encargados directamente de la ejecución de los servicios que integran el contrato, título oficial (original o copia compulsada) que acredite la habilitación legal, competencia profesional y/o formación específica en la materia objeto, con currículo profesional justificativo; o en su caso, certificado del Secretario del Colegio Profesional correspondiente que acredite tal circunstancia. La acreditación se realizará mediante la presentación de los títulos académicos correspondientes o documentación oficial acreditativa de la titulación y, cuando resulte legalmente exigible para el ejercicio de la concreta prestación, de la correspondiente habilitación profesional.
